## API di Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 {#gemini-omni-flash-1-1-api}

Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 è un modello da testo a video, da immagine a video, da riferimento a video e di editing video di Google, disponibile sulla Venice API come `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video`. Le richieste sono anonimizzate, quindi il provider non vede mai la tua identità.

### Prezzi dell'API di Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 {#gemini-omni-flash-1-1-api-pricing}

| ID modello | Variante | Privacy | Prezzo |
|---|---|---|---|
| `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video` | Da testo a video | Anonymized | da $0.0389 / s |
| `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-image-to-video` | Da immagine a video | Anonymized | da $0.0389 / s |
| `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-reference-to-video` | Da riferimento a video | Anonymized | da $0.0389 / s |
| `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-video-to-video` | Modifica video | Anonymized | in base al video sorgente |

Prezzi per clip di `gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video`, senza audio:

| Durata | 360p | 720p | 1080p | 4K |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 4s | $0.16 | $0.47 | $0.70 | $1.40 |
| 6s | $0.23 | $0.70 | $1.05 | $2.10 |
| 8s | $0.31 | $0.93 | $1.40 | $2.80 |
| 10s | $0.39 | $1.17 | $1.75 | $3.50 |

### Come usare l'API di Gemini Omni Flash 1.1 {#how-to-use-the-gemini-omni-flash-1-1-api}

Invia le richieste a `POST https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue` con `"model": "gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video"` e la tua chiave API.

```bash
# 1. Queue the job (returns a queue_id)
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/queue \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{
    "model": "gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video",
    "prompt": "Slow aerial drone shot over a misty mountain valley at golden hour",
    "duration": "4s",
    "resolution": "720p",
    "aspect_ratio": "16:9"
  }'

# 2. Poll until the MP4 is ready
curl https://api.venice.ai/api/v1/video/retrieve \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $VENICE_API_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{ "model": "gemini-omni-flash-1-1-text-to-video", "queue_id": "<queue_id>" }' --output video.mp4
```
